overview: Based on the published agenda, the Kronenwetter Police and Fire Commission was scheduled to meet to review meeting minutes, receive public comment, and conduct a closed session to interview Police Department applicants regarding employment matters.

agenda.item: Closed Session - Consideration of motion to convene into closed session pursuant to Wis. Stat. 19.85 (1)(c) for consideration of employment, promotion, compensation or performance evaluation data of any public employee - to wit, interview Police Department applicants

discussions.body: The commission was scheduled to review and approve the minutes from the previous Police and Fire Commission meeting held on September 28, 2026.

The commission was set to convene into closed session to interview Police Department applicants and consider employment, promotion, compensation, or performance evaluation matters in accordance with Wisconsin Statute 19.85(1)(c). The commission was expected to return to open session following the closed session proceedings.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda with a 15-minute total period and three-minute limit per person, with time extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: Scheduled to approve September 28, 2026 meeting minutes
Expected to consider motion to convene into closed session for Police Department applicant interviews
Expected to consider motion to reconvene into open session
Scheduled to consider action items following closed session
title: Police and Fire Commission Meeting - 2026-11-10
